narrative: 有人已经离开了屋顶。外套很晚才张开。
头发垂下来。街道依然遥远。
用在被推下之后的那个节拍上，当这次坠落应该同时感觉像一首赞美诗和一场灾难时使用它。用在一次悬停上，或者用在实时速度的摄影机坠落上，这个手法就用错了。
如果没有净向下的位移，你拍到的是悬浮（Levitation）。如果整个画面只是被均匀地过卷拍摄放慢，你拍到的只是一次正常坠落的慢动作。
how: 保持向下的位移。让头发、外套和碎屑比躯干更晚受到重力的影响。
如果摄影机是锁定的，身体在一个稳定的画面中缓缓向下漂移。如果摄影机也在下降，建筑或悬崖依然应该呈现出视差，表现出“正在坠落而过”的感觉。
一道侧面主光能让身体与虚空分离开来。说明高度以及下方已经存在的事物。
为一次漂浮坠落（Floating Fall）撰写提示词：一个身体悬在缓慢的坠落中，重力被延迟。对于视频，以缓慢、漂浮的碎片形式坠落，重力被延迟。
when: 用在离开边缘之后的那一秒、坠落的梦境，或者一个应该悬停下来的特技动作上。不要把它用在一次滑稽的楼梯摔倒戏上，除非笑点正是时间变得柔软了。
vs: 悬浮是没有净向下位移的悬停。坠落（Falling）使用的是真实时间的重量感，地面在急速逼近。
慢动作（Slow Motion）是把整个镜头均匀地过卷拍摄。漂浮坠落则是让身体的重力被延迟，而下降本身仍然是情节所在。
examples_film: 《盗梦空间》（Inception）的走廊物理效果把一次坠落变成了穿越建筑的一次漂移。《黑客帝国》里屋顶和街道的坠落场景，让身体悬在被延迟的时间之中。
这是关于重力被延迟的语法，而不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是气球式的悬浮和普通的慢动作。破绽是身体从未下降，或者一次正常的坠落只是被放慢了而已。
解决办法是净向下的位移、被延迟的衣物运动，以及一个清晰可辨的地面。

faq.q: 电影中的“漂浮坠落”是什么？
faq.a: 漂浮坠落是一次重力被延迟的下坠：身体悬在一次缓慢的下降之中，头发和外套姗姗来迟，地面依然遥远。它是一次坠落，而不是一次悬停。

faq.q: 漂浮坠落 vs 悬浮
faq.a: 悬浮停留在空中。漂浮坠落则带着错乱的时钟向下运动。一个需要脚下始终无法合拢的空隙，另一个需要一个正在逼近的地面。

faq.q: 什么时候该用漂浮坠落？
faq.a: 用在被推下之后的那个节拍上，当一次坠落应该悬停下来时。在真正的悬停，以及带有急速逼近地面的实时摄影机坠落中，就跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写漂浮坠落的提示词？
faq.a: 写下Floating fall of [Subject], a body hanging in slow drop, hair and coat in delayed gravity。说明高度和地面。对于视频，说明缓慢漂浮的碎片，路径依然向下。

narrative: Someone has left the roof. The coat opens late.
Hair hangs. The street is still far.
Use it for the beat after the push, when the drop should feel like a hymn and a disaster at once. It is the wrong tool for a hover, and for a real-time camera drop.
If there is no net descent, you shot levitation. If the whole frame is simply overcranked equally, you shot slow motion of a normal fall.
how: Keep downward travel. Delay gravity on hair, coat, and debris more than on the torso.
If the camera is locked, the body drifts down through a stable frame. If the camera also drops, the building or cliff should still parallax as falling-past.
A side-key keeps the body separate from the void. Name the height and what is already below.
Prompt a floating fall: a body hanging in slow drop, delayed gravity. For video, falls in slow, floating pieces, delayed gravity.
when: Use it for the second after leaving the ledge, the dream of dropping, the stunt that should hang. Do not use it for a slapstick trip down stairs unless the joke is that time went soft.
vs: Levitation hovers with no net drop. Falling uses real-time weight, ground rushing.
Slow Motion overcranks the whole shot equally. A floating fall delays gravity on the body while descent remains the plot.
examples_film: Inception 's hallway physics turns a fall into a drift through architecture. The Matrix rooftop and street drops hang bodies in delayed time.
Grammar of delayed gravity, not frames to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousins are balloon Levitation and ordinary Slow Motion. The tell is a body that never descends, or a normal fall that is only slowed.
The fix is net downward travel, delayed cloth, and a readable ground.

faq.q: What is floating fall in film?
faq.a: A floating fall is a drop with delayed gravity: the body hangs in a slow descent, hair and coat late, the ground still far. It is a fall, not a hover.
Levitation stays up. A floating fall goes down with the clock wrong. One needs a gap under the feet that does not close. The other needs a ground that is coming.

faq.q: When should I use floating fall?
faq.a: Use it for the beat after the push, when a drop should hang. Skip it for a true hover, and for a real-time camera fall with rushing ground.

faq.q: How do I prompt floating fall for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write Floating fall of [Subject], a body hanging in slow drop, hair and coat in delayed gravity. Name height and ground. For video, slow floating pieces, path still down.
